messages:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a metronome phasegate shift (blue -> green) tonight 22:00 UTC. Deploy bot scheduled. Need explicit rollback criteria, pinned version list, and a short release-note blurb.
Alex: SGTM. Can we do a 10% step every 3 minutes with a 15m warmup at 5% and 25%? Trying to keep p95 exposure minimal.
Jordan: I'm on call. Suggested automatic abort triggers: p95 latency increase > 250ms sustained for 5m, error rate > 1.5% over 3m, or any 5xx spike > 0.5% of traffic in a 2m window. Also require session-affinity preserved for the first 100k requests.
Tess: Adding: backend saturation alert (GPU mem > 88% for 3m) should also abort. If abort happens, we drain the new green pool and route back to blue immediately.
Ram: Release notes: "Authz cache improvements + router affinity fix". No public downtime. Link: https://docs.internal/release/2024-04-14/metronome-phasegate
Deploy Bot: Scheduled shift created by @Maya for 2024-04-14T22:00:00Z. ID: shift-20240414-009. Steps: 10%,10%,10%,10%,10%,10%,10%,10%,10%,10% (3m step cadence). Watchers: Jordan, Tess.
Deploy Bot: Preflight checks: routing table ok, canary health ok, infra capacity ok, traffic-guard hooks registered. Preflight status: PASS.
Alex: Quick config snippet I pushed to ops-config: 
```
phasegate:
  cadence_minutes: 3
  step_percent: 10
  warmup_percent: 5
  warmup_duration_minutes: 15
  abort_triggers:
    p95_ms: 250
    error_rate_pct: 1.5
    gpu_mem_pct: 88
```
Ram: One more — pin the router-release tag so the traffic split key doesn't drift. Command I ran: `/router pin release metronome-20240414`
Jordan: I'll watch the dashboards and have the rollback runbook open. If abort fires, I'll post "abort shift-20240414-009" and start drain.
Tess: Who's doing the post-shift smoke tests? I can run the auth flow smoke and embedding-runner sanity.
Maya: Tess — thanks, you're on smoke. Alex please confirm the canary seed stays at 1% for 30m after completion.
Alex: Confirmed. Canary seed stays 1% for 30m then decays to 0.5% for ongoing monitoring.
Deploy Bot: Reminder 30m before shift: shift-20240414-009 will start at 2024-04-14T22:00:00Z. Review docs: https://docs.internal/ops/phasegate-runbooks
Jordan: If anything looks off I will call for an immediate abort and tag @oncall-sre.
Maya: Final checklist: release notes published, runbook link in thread, rollback criteria agreed, smoke owners set. All good?
Ram: all good from my side :thumbsup:
Tess: good here :white_check_mark:
Alex: ready.
Jordan: standing by.
Deploy Bot: Shift started. step=1 -> 10% to green. health=ok. p95=120ms err=0.2%
Maya: Watching metrics. step=2 -> 20%
Tess: auth smoke: pass on primary flows.
Alex: Observability: no backend pressure.
Deploy Bot: step=7 -> 70% health=ok p95=130ms err=0.3%
Jordan: not seeing any alerts, latency stable.
Deploy Bot: step=10 -> 100% complete. shift-20240414-009 final status: SUCCESS. Canary seed: maintaining 1% for 30m.
Maya: Great work team — I'll post a short release note in #general after the 30m guard window.
Ram: I'll unpin metronome-20240331 after the 1h stabilization window.
Tess: adding a quick postmortem checklist to the runbook with notes on the affinity fix and rollout cadence.
Jordan: Closing watch. If any regressions surface, we have the abort trace and can revert quickly.
Maya: Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
